Teletalk Professional Package
A package designed exclusively for teachers, engineers, doctors, lawyers and government officials — enjoy discounted call rates, bonus data, and attractive group discounts for association-based applications.
View Pricing Check Eligibility Call Tariff45 Poisha/minTop Data Pack65GB — ৳449Group DiscountUp to 60%
Who This Package Is For:
The Teletalk Professional Package is applicable to the following recognized professional categories:
Teachers, Engineers, Government Officers, Doctors and Lawyers.
Members of their registered associations may also avail this package, either individually or as an association-based group.
Proof of Eligibility Required
A valid ID card / registration number from your professional association must be presented and submitted when collecting the SIM. Each professional may obtain only one SIM per NID.

Why Customers Should Choose This Package:
Affordable Call Rate:
Just 45 poisha/min with a 10-second pulse for the first 6 months — significant savings over regular rates.
Extra Bonus Data:
Every data pack includes generous bonus volume, so you enjoy more data for your money.
Professional Recognition:
An exclusive package based on your verified professional identity — recognizing your contribution.
Group Discounts:
SIM prices step down progressively as your association's member count grows.
All-in-One Bundles:
Minutes, SMS and data combined — no need to purchase separate packages.
Easy & Quick Access:
Available conveniently through Teletalk's corporate wing and customer service centers.
Package Availability & Terms and Conditions
How To Avail The Package:
Check Eligibility:
Confirm that you belong to one of the recognized professional categories.
Collect Proof:
Keep your association ID card with registration number and NID ready.
Visit Nearest Center:
Reach out to Teletalk's corporate wing or a customer service center.
Get SIM & Enjoy:
Activate your SIM and start enjoying special rates, data and bundle benefits.
Terms & Conditions
This package is applicable only to approved professionals.
A valid ID card / registration number bearing the registration number of the relevant professional association must be presented and submitted at the time of SIM collection.
Each professional may obtain only one SIM against one NID.
The default call tariff and pulse are applicable for 6 months from the date of activation.
Supplementary duty, VAT and surcharge are applicable on all tariffs.
Supplementary duty, VAT and surcharge are included with data package and bundle prices.
For further details, please contact your nearest Teletalk corporate wing or customer service center. Terms are subject to change without prior notice.
